grading: Each answer must satisfy its frozen expected content, identity, uncertainty and format; no replacement by retries. Human/agent semantic grading, not an independent blinded evaluator.
method: 200 new questions, frozen before any are submitted. Strict first attempts, partials/errors nonpass. Actual seeded database snapshot, in-memory core database adapter; live model, not production API/browser. No application edits during the run.
